hotelDesc.overview:
Experience Luxury and Convenience at Saigon Prince Hotel

Welcome to Saigon Prince Hotel, a premier 4.5-star hotel located in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. With its prime location and exceptional amenities, this hotel offers a perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience for both business and leisure travelers. Step into our elegant lobby and be greeted by our friendly and attentive staff, ready to cater to your every need. From the moment you arrive, you'll experience the warm Vietnamese hospitality that sets Saigon Prince Hotel apart. With 191 well-appointed rooms, you'll find the perfect accommodation to suit your needs. Each room is designed with your comfort in mind, featuring modern amenities and stylish decor. Whether you're traveling alone or with your family, our spacious rooms provide a peaceful retreat after a day of exploring the city. Check-in is available from 02:00 PM, allowing you to settle in and start your vacation at your own pace. The hotel's last renovation in 2013 ensures that you'll enjoy modern facilities and a contemporary ambiance throughout your stay. And when it's time to bid farewell to this vibrant city, check-out is until 12:00 PM, giving you ample time to pack and prepare for your departure. Saigon Prince Hotel is conveniently located just 40 minutes away from the airport, making it a hassle-free journey to and from the hotel. Situated only 0.1 km from the city center, you'll have easy access to the city's top attractions, shopping districts, and entertainment venues. Families traveling with children between the ages of 5 to 11 will be delighted to know that Saigon Prince Hotel offers a child-friendly policy. Children within this age range can stay free of charge, ensuring a memorable and affordable family vacation. Experience the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience at Saigon Prince Hotel. Book your stay with us today and indulge in an unforgettable experience in Ho Chi Minh City.

Unwind and Indulge in Exciting Entertainment Facilities at Saigon Prince Hotel

At Saigon Prince Hotel, your entertainment needs are taken care of with a range of fantastic facilities. Whether you're looking to relax, have fun, or explore, this hotel has it all. Step into a world of retail therapy at the hotel's shops, where you can browse through a variety of clothing, accessories, and souvenirs. Discover unique treasures to take home and cherish as a memory of your stay in Ho Chi Minh City. After a day of exploring the city, head to the stylish bar at Saigon Prince Hotel. Sip on expertly crafted cocktails or indulge in a glass of wine as you unwind and soak in the vibrant atmosphere. The bar offers a wide selection of beverages, ensuring there's something to suit every taste. For the ultimate relaxation experience, visit the steamroom at the hotel. Let the warm steam envelop your senses as you rejuvenate your body and mind. This tranquil oasis is the perfect place to unwind after a long day of sightseeing or business meetings. In addition, the gift/souvenir shop at Saigon Prince Hotel is a must-visit. Browse through a variety of unique gifts and souvenirs to take home for yourself or your loved ones. From traditional handicrafts to local delicacies, you'll find something special to commemorate your stay in Vietnam. Saigon Prince Hotel goes above and beyond to provide an array of entertainment facilities that cater to your every need. Whether you're looking to shop, relax, or bring home a piece of Vietnam, this hotel has it all.

Stay Active at Saigon Prince Hotel's Impressive Sports Facilities

Saigon Prince Hotel in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, offers an array of top-notch sports facilities to ensure that guests can stay active and energized during their stay. The hotel boasts a state-of-the-art fitness center equipped with modern exercise machines and equipment, making it the perfect place to break a sweat and maintain your fitness routine. Whether you prefer cardio workouts or strength training, the fitness center at Saigon Prince Hotel has everything you need to achieve your fitness goals. In addition to the fitness center, guests can take a refreshing dip in the hotel's outdoor pool. Surrounded by lush greenery and offering stunning views of the city skyline, the pool provides a serene and tranquil environment for relaxation and rejuvenation. Whether you want to swim a few laps to stay in shape or simply lounge by the poolside with a refreshing drink, the outdoor pool at Saigon Prince Hotel is the perfect spot to unwind after a long day of exploring the city. What sets Saigon Prince Hotel apart is that it offers complimentary access to its 24-hour fitness center. This means that guests can work out at any time that suits their schedule, ensuring that fitness enthusiasts and busy travelers alike can maintain their exercise routine without any constraints. Whether you are an early bird who likes to start the day with a workout or a night owl who prefers a late-night fitness session, the 24-hour fitness center at Saigon Prince Hotel has got you covered.

Convenience Facilities at Saigon Prince Hotel

Discover a world of convenience at Saigon Prince Hotel, where every guest's needs are catered to with a range of exceptional facilities. Enjoy the luxury of 24-hour room service, ensuring that you can indulge in delicious meals or snacks at any time of the day or night. Take advantage of the laundry service, allowing you to effortlessly keep your clothes fresh and clean throughout your stay. Additionally, the hotel offers room service for added convenience. For your peace of mind, Saigon Prince Hotel provides safety deposit boxes, allowing you to securely store your valuables during your visit. The dedicated concierge team is always on hand to assist with any requests or recommendations, ensuring that your stay is as enjoyable as possible. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi in public areas, allowing you to easily browse the internet or stay in touch with loved ones. If you prefer to smoke, there is a designated smoking area available. Stay connected and productive with free Wi-Fi in all rooms, ensuring that you can easily work or stay in touch with friends and family. The hotel also offers dry cleaning services, making it convenient for you to keep your clothes in pristine condition. With express check-in/check-out facilities, you can save time and start enjoying your stay without any delay. For your convenience, luggage storage is available, allowing you to securely store your belongings before check-in or after check-out. Finally, the daily housekeeping service ensures that your room is always clean and tidy, providing you with a comfortable and enjoyable stay at Saigon Prince Hotel.

Convenient Transport Facilities at Saigon Prince Hotel

Saigon Prince Hotel offers a range of convenient transport facilities to ensure a hassle-free stay for its guests. Arriving at the hotel is a breeze with the airport transfer service, which provides a comfortable and efficient journey from Tan Son Nhat International Airport. For those looking to explore the vibrant city of Ho Chi Minh, the hotel offers a variety of tour options, allowing guests to discover the city's iconic landmarks and hidden gems. Additionally, the hotel provides a car park onsite, ensuring that guests have a secure and convenient place to park their vehicles. To further enhance guests' convenience, Saigon Prince Hotel offers a shuttle service, making it easy to navigate the city and visit popular attractions. For those who prefer to drive themselves, the hotel also offers car hire services. Additionally, guests can take advantage of the ticket service to easily book tickets for shows, events, and attractions. Whether guests choose to utilize the car park, shuttle service, or car hire, Saigon Prince Hotel ensures that transportation needs are well taken care of.

Luxurious Room Facilities at Saigon Prince Hotel

Experience ultimate comfort and convenience at Saigon Prince Hotel with its range of luxurious room facilities. Each room is equipped with air conditioning, ensuring a cool and comfortable stay throughout your visit. Wrap yourself in soft bathrobes provided in every room, adding an extra touch of indulgence to your stay. Stay updated with the latest news by enjoying a complimentary daily newspaper delivered right to your doorstep. For entertainment options, Saigon Prince Hotel offers in-house movies for you to enjoy in the comfort of your room. Get ready for a night out with the help of a hairdryer provided in each room. Relax and unwind while watching your favorite shows on the television with satellite/cable TV channels. Quench your thirst with a selection of beverages from the well-stocked mini bar in your room. With these exceptional room facilities, Saigon Prince Hotel ensures a memorable and enjoyable stay for all guests.

Delicious Dining Options at Saigon Prince Hotel

Saigon Prince Hotel offers a range of dining facilities to satisfy every palate. Convenient Transportation Options from the Airport to Saigon Prince Hotel

Taxis are readily available outside the terminal, and the ride to the hotel takes around 20 minutes, depending on traffic conditions. policyNotes:
- As per the law, a foreigner cannot share a room with a citizen of Vietnam without a certificate of marriage as a proof. The property may reject the booking or request that a second room be booked upon failure to do so.
- The hotel offers cable internet service in all guest rooms and the computer in the business center at no additional charge.
- Club Lounge benefits will be provided when booked with room types: Club room, Club Suite room, Club Grand Suite room, and Apartments with details as below:
- Buffet breakfast at Ocean Queen Restaurant or Continental breakfast at the Club Lounge.
- Afternoon tea & snacks will be provided daily from 14:00 to 17:00
- Evening cocktails & canapés will be provided daily from 17:30 to 19:30
- Tea, coffee, and soft drinks daily served at Club Lounge
- Late check-out until 15:00 and subject to availability.
- 1-hour use of the Club Lounge meeting room per day (subject to availability)
- 15% discount offered to the hotel transportation service.
- At check-in, the hotel requires guests to present a valid photo ID with your address confirming the same name as the lead guest on the booking.
- The hotel requires guests to provide credit card or cash deposit upon check-in.
- For bookings paid with a credit card, you must present the card used to make the payment upon check-in. Failure to show the credit card used for payment to our reception team may result in the hotel requesting additional payment or your reservation not being honored.
All rooms are guaranteed on the day of arrival. In the case of a no-show, your room(s) will be released, and you will be subject to the terms and conditions of the Cancellation/No-Show Policy specified at the time you made the booking as well as noted in the Confirmation Email.
- All guestrooms at this property are non-smoking.

- In case additional children show up at check-in (not listed in the booking):
Children from 6 to under 12 years old will be subject to a surcharge in accordance with the hotel’s policy, payable directly at the Front Desk.
• Children from 12 years old and above will be charged as adults, based on the hotel’s current rates.
• The extra bed service will incur an additional charge as per hotel policy, payable at the Front Desk.
• In case a room accommodates 02 children from 6 to under 12 years old sharing with 02 adults, 01 extra bed will be required and charged in accordance with the hotel’s policy, payable at the Front Desk.
